summary.zh: 用模板加数据批量生成落地页并控风险
summary.en: Generate many SEO pages from a template and data

description.zh: 用模板和数据批量产出地区页、集成页、对比页或目录页，先设计 URL 规则，再检查内容单薄带来的降权风险。适合需要成规模覆盖长尾关键词、又不想每页手写时使用。
description.en: Builds location, integration, comparison or directory pages from a template and data, starting with URL patterns and guarding against thin-content penalties. Use it to cover long-tail keywords at scale.
